summary.headline: Sai Silks Q2 FY27 revenue fell 2.3% YoY to INR 434 crore on festive shift; SSSG down 10.6%, management reiterates FY27 INR 1,850-1,900 crore target.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR 434 crore versus INR 444 crore in Q2 FY26, with gross margin up 20 bps to 42%, EBITDA of INR 62 crore (14.2% margin) and PAT of INR 31 crore (7.2% margin). H1 FY27 revenue was INR 809 crore (down 1.7%) and H1 SSSG was -9.2%, with Q2 SSSG at -10.6%, both attributed to Adhik Maas and Dussehra moving from September into October. Sequentially, revenue rose 15.7% and EBITDA rose 18.8% from Q1. Management says festive demand in Q3 is much stronger and expects double-digit SSSG and revenue growth in H2 with the full-year target unchanged.

segments.name: Kalamandir
segments.commentary: Mass-premium middle and upper-middle class format; opened new stores in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, with management saying the Karnataka expansion will slow.

segments.name: Varamahalakshmi Silks
segments.commentary: Traditional silk and wedding wear format; management expects a stronger Q3 and says it will keep opening stores. Tamil Nadu productivity was about INR 36,000 per sq ft in H1 against a target of INR 45,000-48,000 by FY27-end.

segments.name: Mandir
segments.commentary: Premium ethnic wear format; no segment-level figures disclosed in the call.

segments.name: KLM Fashion Mall
segments.commentary: Ethnic value format; one store (about 20,000 sq ft) closed in H1. Management says it is on a recovery path and will give a detailed plan at end of Q3.

segments.name: Valli Silks
segments.commentary: Affordable traditional format opened last year; no expansion since. Management is waiting for maturity and will assess unit economics by year-end.

guidance_outlook: Management reiterates full-year FY27 revenue target of INR 1,850-1,900 crore, double-digit revenue growth, and full-year SSSG of about 5%.
Expects double-digit positive SSSG in H2 FY27, following negative H1 SSSG of -9.2%.
Analyst cited an expected 17.5-18% EBITDA margin for H2 and a 9.5% PAT margin for FY27; management did not confirm the margin figures and said FY27 margin guidance will be discussed at the end of Q3.
No share buyback planned; board decided current PE of about 7-8x does not warrant one.
Plans to enter new states such as Maharashtra and Kerala, and to slow Karnataka expansion while restarting Tamil Nadu expansion.
capex_capacity: 86 stores and about 820,000 sq ft retail area as of September 30, 2026, after six openings (about 56,000 sq ft) and one KLM closure (about 20,000 sq ft) in H1 FY27.
100% company-owned, company-operated model; sourcing from more than 4,000 weavers, artisans and vendors.
Inventory build-up planned for Q3 ahead of Diwali and Sankranti/Pongal; management says inventory should normalize on a YoY basis.
Silver jewellery is a small test in three stores with about INR 6-7 crore inventory; no major expansion planned.
Ugadi season in Karnataka may shift a few wedding dates from Q4 into Q1 FY28.
demand_pricing: Festive-to-festive business (Navaratri) grew more than 27-30% YoY, with ASP, ABV and all KPIs up across formats, per management.
Raw material costs up about 5-6%; company passes on increases where possible and absorbs the rest, with a focus on keeping prices below competitors at each store.
Regional competition in AP and Telangana from clearance exhibitions is expected to continue through Q3 and Q4; company responded with store-level marketing.

Management says there is no material risk from poor rainfall, El Nino, UPI MDR charges, or the Andhra cyclone (a one-day store closure). Andhra and Tamil Nadu are expected to be major markets in the next two to three months.
Wedding dates for FY27 are said to be evenly spread across H2, with about 98 dates next year versus 63-65 in a typical year (per a report cited by the CFO).

qa_highlights.question: Inventory turns have fallen from about 3x in FY18-20 to 1.5-2x; what is the medium-term target and can payables be raised?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said inventory days have improved by 20-30 days over three years and that festive/wedding retail needs higher stock. CFO said efforts will be made to improve the balance sheet by year-end, but month-to-month movements will vary with seasonality.

qa_highlights.question: Why not do a share buyback given the stock trades below book value?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the stock trades at 7-8x PE and that the board decided a buyback is not appropriate; funds are better deployed in the business.

qa_highlights.question: Quantify Navaratri demand versus last year and provide SSSG by format.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said festive-to-festive growth was over 27-30% and that the Q2 negative SSSG reflects the calendar shift. No format-level SSSG was given.

qa_highlights.question: What drives the double-digit H2 SSSG and revenue growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO cited the Dussehra and Adhik Maas shift into H2, pricing adjustments to pass on raw material inflation, new stores in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka that perform well in Diwali, and marketing efforts in lower-productivity areas.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR 1,900 crore revenue and margin outlook still valid?
qa_highlights.answer: CEO said the target remains INR 1,850-1,900 crore with no change. CFO declined to confirm H2 EBITDA margin of 17.5-18% and deferred it to the Q3 call.

qa_highlights.question: What is the plan for KLM Fashion Mall given weak growth and value-retail competition?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said KLM is on a recovery path with company interventions and that a detailed plan will be presented at the end of Q3.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Tamil Nadu productivity trajectory and the Karnataka store strategy?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said Tamil Nadu reached about INR 36,000 per sq ft in H1, with expected improvement in H2. CEO said Karnataka expansion will slow and new states such as Maharashtra and Kerala are being explored.

qa_highlights.question: What are the unit economics of the Valli format and will expansion resume?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said Valli stores were only opened last year and the format is still maturing; unit economics will be known by year-end.

risks_watch: H2 SSSG recovery to double digits is central to the FY27 target; H1 SSSG was -9.2%, so the H2 gap is large.
Inventory turns of about 1.5-2x and a high inventory build ahead of Q3 and Q4; working capital needs to be watched at year-end.
KLM Fashion Mall has weak growth and no new stores; its Q3 update is the key checkpoint.
Regional competition from clearance exhibitions in AP and Telangana; Tamil Nadu productivity is still below the INR 45,000-48,000 per sq ft target.
Unclear FY27 EBITDA margin guidance (analyst cites 17.5-18%); management deferred confirmation to the Q3 call.
Raw material inflation of 5-6% against the company's ability to pass it on in price.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H2 recovery and the full-year target, but evasive on specifics: it declined to confirm FY27 margin guidance, KLM plans and Valli economics, deferring them to the Q3 call. Management was also dismissive of a buyback and of the inventory-turn concern.
key_quotes: We expect business momentum to normalize in the second half with a return to positive and double -digit same -store sales growth supporting our expectation of double -digit revenue growth for the full year.

Most importantly, we remain net debt negative with a healthy cash balance of approximately INR 249 crore, providing financial flexibility to support seasonal working capital requirements and aggressive planned expansion.
Even now, the share is trading at a 7 -8 PE. A buyback is not an appropriate option, as it involves investing substantial funds.

rows.label: KLM Fashion Mall recovery plan
